title: PBX3 fleet DID record (v0)
description: One E.164 number assigned to a tenant. Used inside tenants/{shortuid}/dids.json and optionally as catalog/dids/{e164_key}.json for conditional assign.

sip_prefix.description: Optional OpenSIPS dr_rules prefix (digits as carrier presents R-URI user). Default = e164 without +. Lab Magrathea often needs UK national e.g. 01924918076 while e164 is +441924918076. Required when delivery=block (shorter than e164 digits).

delivery.description: Hop-1 OpenSIPS match kind. singleton = full number (sip_prefix or e164 digits); block = shorter sip_prefix covering a range. Fleet Allocate sets this; projector uses sip_prefix as dr_rules.prefix.

tenant_shortuid.description: Required on standalone catalog/dids/{e164_key}.json; omitted when nested under tenants/{shortuid}/dids.json

status.description: active = routable; reserved = assigned but not yet in tenant inroutes; porting = cutover pending; released = soft-delete, not routable

carrier.description: Carrier of record or trunk label (ops metadata, optional)

notes.description: Operator notes (port-in ref, ticket id, etc.)
